basic_info.description: In the same family since its construction in 1907, this trophy Noe Valley fixer is awaiting revival. This handsome home offers spacious & formal rooms, period details, an opportunity to make a perfect floor plan, and a strong street presence. Endless possibilities span three levels, over 2,800 square feet of living space, situated on a 25 foot x 100 foot lot. Nestled above the street, lovely western light is enjoyed through bay windows, and views to the bay from the top two levels. Located on a quiet street with quick proximity to Noe Valley's 24th Street corridor, parks, and playgrounds.
